summary: Frontend-only testing completed with new targeted edit-plan unit suite plus mobile preview checks. In real mobile web preview, AI Tour login/load/generate/edit modal flows work; recalc failures now surface visibly in modal footer instead of silent close.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `bash /app/tests/aitour/run_suite.sh` and `bash /app/tests/verification/run_verification_suite.sh`. New edit-plan suite is included in run_suite.
